How it works

Three steps, no new app

Everything happens inside the WhatsApp chat you already have open.

01

Message what you need

Tell us the grade, subject and material — a lesson plan, worksheet, test, or report comment.

02

We build it to CAPS

Your request is matched to the CAPS curriculum for that grade and phase, and drafted in seconds.

03

Download and teach

Receive a print-ready PDF straight in the chat — save it, forward it, or ask for changes.
